use_case_summary: RAG for legal/compliance discovery: embeddings index + ANN for candidate retrieval, followed by neural reranker for precision. High recall required; must support threaded queries across case folders and retain audit trail of queries/results for regulatory purposes.
technical_requirements: Index size: target 8-12M docs, avg doc 1-2k tokens; support shard/partition planning
Latency: p95 < 250ms for retrieval+rerank (SLO for interactive review)
Throughput: sustained 30 qps during peak review windows, spike to 120 qps for batch ingest queries
Cost constraints: target $0.03-$0.10 per query for retrieval+rerank (customer sensitive)
Model preferences: open-model embeddings (vector dim 1536) + reranker LLM (2-7B) that can run in private infra
Routing/fallback: must support fallback to smaller quantized model under capacity pressure
Data controls: VPC-only control plane, customer-managed KMS, audit logs shipped to SIEM, retention configurable per-case
Compliance: 7-year retention for certain matter types, exportable audit trail for e-discovery requests
security_notes: They require SAML SSO integration, per-token audit logging, and immutable retention policies for privileged matters. Legal: 'we cannot delete session logs for 7 years for financial investigations' — needs retention controls & legal hold support. Asked for HSM/KMS proof-of-concept and SOC2/ISO artefacts.
poC_plan: Phase 1: ingest 1.7M docs in private VPC, validate retrieval recall/precision with sample prompts. Phase 2: add learned reranker, measure p95 latency and cost per query. Phase 3: run 30-day shadow traffic and provide retention/audit export demos.
current_proof_points: Proof-of-concept requirement: show 250ms p95 for 5k candidate rerank; demo of per-query audit log to S3 + SIEM; model quantization options to hit cost targets.
